sql:
SELECT json_build_object(
 'hist_sem_empresa', (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_history WHERE company_id IS NULL),
 'sem_empresa_com_lead', (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_history h WHERE h.company_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.id = h.lead_id)),
 'gatilho', (SELECT json_agg(tgname || ' enabled=' || tgenabled) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'public.lead_history'::regclass AND tgname = 'trg_lead_history_fill_company'),
 'funcao', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'fn_lead_history_fill_company'),
 'politicas_delete', (SELECT json_agg(policyname || ': ' || coalesce(qual,'')) FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename='lead_history' AND cmd='DELETE'),
 'ultimos_registros_sem_empresa_24h', (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_history WHERE company_id IS NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
 'registros_ultima_hora', (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_history WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 hour')
)
